forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: Break cycles by moving shared rules to src/shared/lib/ or keeping dependencies in one direction between module public APIs.

forbidden.name: module-public-api
forbidden.comment: Import another module through index.ts, server.ts or actions/<name>-action.ts; keep internal imports inside their own module.

forbidden.name: shared-not-modules
forbidden.comment: Move feature-specific consumers to src/modules/<module>/; shared/ code may depend only on shared infrastructure.

forbidden.name: domain-pure-core
forbidden.comment: Put Node I/O in src/modules/<module>/server/; keep domain/ functions pure.

forbidden.name: domain-pure-path
forbidden.comment: Put React UI in components/ and Next or I/O code in server/ or actions/; keep domain/ functions pure.

forbidden.name: shared-not-backend
forbidden.comment: Call the backend client from src/modules/<module>/server/; shared/ code stays independent of the backend.

forbidden.name: domain-not-backend
forbidden.comment: Read data through the backend client in src/modules/<module>/server/ and pass it into domain/; keep domain/ functions pure.

forbidden.name: backend-self-contained
forbidden.comment: Keep src/backend/ to the client and its generated types, using only src/shared/lib/; feature code that calls it belongs in src/modules/<module>/server/.

forbidden.name: not-to-test
forbidden.comment: Keep test fixtures and assertions in colocated *.test.ts(x) files; move reusable production logic to domain/ or src/shared/lib/.
